summary.text: Peter Warren is the Republican candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 2nd Hampden District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Brian Michael Ashe.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as sales consultant, and in a survey he said he is retired after 36 years in the commercial alarm field.

paragraphs.text: Peter Warren said in a Ballotpedia survey that he held multiple roles during his 36 years in the commercial alarm field, from field work to general management.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

He listed his campaign priorities as carrying out the state auditor audit of the Legislature that voters approved in 2024, adequate state funding for cities and towns, protecting Proposition 2 1/2, and affordability, including phasing in new power technologies more gradually.
He also said he would support an amendment giving Massachusetts residents, and veterans first among them, priority under the state's right-to-shelter law.
He listed former State Representative Mary Rogeness as an endorser.
